name: features.within_radius
description: Features within radius (meters) of a point
querySql: SELECT f.id, f.external_id, f.source_table, ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geometry)::jsonb AS geometry, ST_Distance(f.geometry::geography, ST_Point(:lon, :lat, 4326)::geography) AS distance_m, f.attributes FROM tessera.geo_features f WHERE ST_DWithin(f.geometry::geography, ST_Point(:lon, :lat, 4326)::geography, :radiusMeters) ORDER BY distance_m LIMIT :limit
